LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_Intro: Schedule Date or Lovin on the Schedule tab. Date is a walk / table / hangout (mood + opinion, no bed). Lovin still uses a shared double. Adults without a partner in that bed can have private time. Ideology that forbids lovin, and Biotech sterile genes, reroute to a date instead of forcing the job.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_PregnancySafeTip: ON (recommended): only shortens lovin chance while scheduled; keeps vanilla post-lovin cooldown. OFF with Eager: mirrors Always Do Lovin cooldown (~100 ticks).
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_EagerTip: Shortens post-lovin cooldown like the Always Do Lovin debug option. Can spam pregnancy rolls — leave off unless you want that.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_SelfLovinTip: Adults on Lovin hours use their own bed when a partner is not sharing a double. No pregnancy. Same cooldown as lovin. Children never qualify.
LanguageData.DateNight_Settings_WindowBedTip: Temporarily assign the rendezvous double to the couple for the Lovin window, then restore their previous beds. Off if you want to assign beds yourself.
